hook_variants: Three hundred people die on ladders every year. Almost none of them were high up.
The most dangerous rung on a ladder is the one you think is safe.
You are more likely to die falling six feet than sixty.

beats.narration: Three hundred people die on ladders every year.

visual.intent: worker climbing an extension ladder on a job site

beats.narration: Almost none of them were high up. Most fell from under ten feet.
Here is the rule that prevents it. For every four feet of height, pull the base one foot out.

visual.intent: ladder leaning against a wall at a correct angle

cta: Check the angle before you climb.
